description:
The row type returned by get_changes_since_ordered has inconsistent visibility across the sibling stores:

- crates/kith-store/src/chat.rs line 9:    pub type ChatChangeRow = (String, i64, bool);
- crates/kith-store/src/contact.rs line 8: type ContactChangeRow = (String, i64, bool);   // private
- crates/kith-store/src/message.rs line 12: type ChangeRow = (String, i64, bool);          // private, different name

ChatChangeRow is exported from the crate (used by kith-chat handlers), but the contact and message equivalents are private type aliases with different names. This means callers of get_changes_since_ordered on ChatStore can name the row type, but callers on ContactStore and MessageStore cannot.

Additionally, the type names are inconsistent: ChatChangeRow, ContactChangeRow (contact), ChangeRow (message). All three represent the same semantic (id, change_counter, is_create).

Fix: settle on a single name (e.g., StoreChangeRow) exported from kith-store, and use it for all three store modules.
title: ChatChangeRow is pub type but ContactChangeRow is private type — inconsistent visibility for symmetric row types
